newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 2.8 billion yuan from 2.4 billion on Monday, with the 60-day contract the most active.
Traders said borrowing by financial institutions short of funds needed to settle year-end accounts was the main reason for the 60-day contract being the most active.
"The year-end is the time that big state-run banks usually need funds to settle accounts," said one trader. "So banks reduce their lending, causing trading volume to drop."
Traders expect the rates to move in a narrow range around current levels in lower volume in the short term.
